|lore=Cheap astromech droid commonly referred to as 'Red.' Purposely blew his motivator to prevent splitting up R2-D2 and C-3PO on Tatooine. Poor navigator but skilled mechanic.
|joke=The lore says he blew his motivator on purpose, to keep R2-D2 and C-3PO together. In ''Star Wars'' it just blows, and Luke tells his uncle "This R2 unit has a bad motivator."<ref name="imsdb-anh">[https://imsdb.com/scripts/Star-Wars-A-New-Hope.html Star Wars: A New Hope script], IMSDb. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260720032511/https://imsdb.com/scripts/Star-Wars-A-New-Hope.html Internet Archive], 20 July 2026.</ref> And as a "skilled mechanic", he could fix himself later. On the cards, R5-D4 adds 1 to power aboard a starship, while R2-D2, the droid he stepped aside for, adds 2 aboard a starfighter. See [[Jokes#R5-D4 (Arfive-Defour)|Jokes]].
|game_text=While aboard any starship, adds 1 to power and maneuver. During your control phase, if aboard your starship damaged by an ion cannon, restores armor/maneuver and hyperspeed.
